Do you remember the first time you reversed out of your parents' driveway? That feeling is pure freedom. But for your parents, that moment may have been one of the scariest times of their lives. When you were a teenager, there was simply no way for your parents to know how fast you were driving, where you went, when you arrived, or how safely you were driving, and so on. No news was good news, and hope was the only real tool until you called to report that you were safe.

If you now have a teenage driver, be grateful that today you don't have to relive the dread of the unknown that your parents' generation endured. There's plenty negative about 2026's technology, but HeyPolo is a prime example of how technology is making life better and safer for teen drivers.

HeyPolo is much more than just a paid version of Apple's "Find My" service.

HeyPolo is a family safety app, and one price covers real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features. The driving features are what set it apart from general location-sharing apps like Apple's "Find My." Every single trip your teen driver takes is recorded and scored, so you can clearly see the specifics of the trip: how fast they were going, whether they used their smartphone while driving, any hard braking or rapid acceleration, and whether any serious driving incidents were detected.

The "Driving Score" rates each trip based on actual driving behaviour, so you're no longer left guessing whether your teen is really driving safely. You can see the data, and if their performance isn't ideal, you can have a genuine conversation, and as their habits improve, you'll see the score gradually rise. Compared to anything available to previous generations, this is a far more practical way to help new drivers improve behind the wheel.

Crash detection, arrival alerts, and more handy features

HeyPolo automatically detects crashes and notifies you. Combined with arrival alerts, whether your child gets to school, arrives at sports practice, meets up with friends, or returns home, you can move from merely hoping for "no news is good news" to actually knowing whether they are safe. You won't have to wait for them to text or call after they've arrived; you'll know immediately when they get there, and that peace of mind for parents is truly priceless. HeyPolo updates every 5 seconds, so your location information is always accurate.

One price, the whole family can use it

A single HeyPolo subscription covers your entire family, absolutely no extra per-person fees. It works great on both iPhone and Android, so it's no problem if your household has a mix of devices. HeyPolo is developed by the team behind Surfshark, which means they have a very solid privacy infrastructure backing them up. They won't sell your data, you can control who you share how much with and when you stop sharing, and all data is deleted every 7 days. For an app centred on location, this is very important from a privacy perspective.

HeyPolo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, and if you and your family try it and feel it's not right for you, there are no binding contracts, so there's absolutely no reason not to give it a try.
